items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: so he was telling me, he said, man, I used to look, I used to look at that old tall son

ctx.x: So he was playing with Earl Hines, and, because I went there to see George Foster, they were playing in Detroit, so he was telling me, he said, man, I used to look, I used to look at that old tall son, look unfair, that clarinet, and said, God, if I could only play like him, nah, that's what Donnell says, you know, he was a great clarinet player. And, uh, Wooden Joe used to play clarinet, too.
Oh yes, I knew him, they'd trumpet mostly, that way.
